addons.name: Ziri's Toolkit
addons.description: Small helpers in one addon: Loot Highlight, Fresh Ranks, cleanse buttons, thanking people who buff you, an undress button, boat times, a tidier friends list, an instance limit counter, rested XP per character, buff reminders, a flight timer, threat for tanks, a healer mana warning, a disconnect tracker and a page for console settings.
